sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Light Machine Guns is a Combat skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Light Machinegun handling skill improves the overall handling, reduces recoil and reload time of LMGs.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Level 5 of this skill is needed for the story chapter Batya

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases reload speed (0.4% per level → +20% at Elite Level)
- Increases weapon switching speed (0.8% per level → +40% at Elite Level)
- Reduces weapon recoil (0.3% per level → -15% at Elite Level)
- Improves weapon ergonomics (0.2% per level → +10% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Steady aim for the first 3 seconds with any stamina condition
- Elite level: Doubles mastering gain

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Landing hits on enemies with Light machine Guns
- Reloading Light machine Guns
- Cycling the action/Unloading the chambers of Light machine Guns
- Landing hits on enemies with Stationary weapons
- Completing the quest Consolation Prize
- Completing the quest Getting Some Air
- Completing the quest Unique Experience
